rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING FURTHER THE RIGHT OF DAUGHTERS AGAINST INCESTUOUS RAPE BY PENALIZING MOTHERS WHO REFRAIN FROM PROCEEDING AGAINST THE FATHER-RAPISTS OR TOLERATE ITS CIMMISSION
rows.abstract: Notwithstanding any law to the contrary and without prejudice to the provisions of Article 344 of Act No. 3815, as amended, (Revised Penal Code) and Section 27 of R.A. No. 7610, any mother who, in an incestous rape, refrains from instituting prosecution for the punishment of the offender or who tolerates the commission of the same, shall suffer the penalty of twenty (20) to torty (40) years of imprisonment and a fine ranging from twenty thousand pesos (P20,000.00) to forty thousand pesos (P40,000.00) and shall be perpetually deprived from parental authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2001-08-06

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE DEVOLUTION OF THE CONTROL, MANAGEMENT AND OPERATION OF MUNICIPAL OR TERTIARY PORTS FROM THE PHILIPPINE PORTS AUTHORITY TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to clarify the inconsistencies under the PPA charter in relation to the operational concept of devolution and revenue collection under the Local Government Code, by transferring the control, management and operation of municipal ports as well as revenue collection and other activities pertinent thereto from the PPA to the LGUs.  This will enable LGUs to be self-reliant communities and make them effective partners in the realization of national goals.

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENTITLING THE WORKER THE OPTION TO BE PAID SEPARATION PAY IN LIEU OF REINSTATEMENT IN ILLEGAL DISMISSAL CASES WHERE REINSTATEMENT IS ORDERED, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 279 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: In illegal dismissal cases, Article 279 of the Labor Code provides remedies available to the workers, namely: reinstatement and entitlement to full backwages. This bill broadens this provision by allowing payment of separation pay in lieu of reinstatement - another alternative available to illegally dismissed employees under Article 279 of the Labor Code.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2001-08-06

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE CRIME OF RAPE AGAINST A HOUSEHELPER UNDER EIGHTEEN (18) YEARS OF AGE COMMITTED BY HER EMPLOYER A HEINOUS CRIME AND IMPOSING THE MANDATORY PENALTY OF DEATH THEREOF, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 335 OF REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Among the many women workers that should be included in the ambit of protection by these constitutional provisions are the househelpers. Because of the nature of their work, they become gullible to crimes against chastity.  As they perform their duties, they may fall prey into the hands of their employer, as most of them are young female dropouts from the elementary and secondary schools and are uninitiated in the wiles of life.  This bill seeks to impose the maximum penalty of death upon the offender who rapes a househelper under eighteen (18) years of age if committed by her employer, a member of the employer's household of a co-househelper.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2001-08-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A CHILDREN'S WELFARE FUND FOR THE PROTECTION AND REHABILITATION OF ABANDONED ABUSED AND SEXUALLY EXPLOITED CHILDREN, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7610, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS "THE SPECIAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AGAINST CHILD ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION ACT"
rows.abstract: It shall be the policy of the State to recognize the vital role of the youth in nation-building .  Towards this end, it shall promote and protect their physical, moral, spiritual, intellectual and social well-being. There shall be incorporated afterSec. 30 of R.A. No. 7610 to read as follows: SEC. 31. CHILDREN'S WELFARE FUND FOR ABANDONED, ABUSED AND SEXUALLY EXPLOITED CHILDREN. - IN ORDER TO EFFECTIVELY PROTECT AND REHABILITATE CHILDREN WHO ARE VICTIMS OF ALL FORMS OF ABUSE AND SEXUAL EXPLOITATION, THERE IS HEREBY ESTABLISHED A PROTECTION AND REHABILITATION FUND FOR ABUSED AND SEXUALLY EXPLOITED CHILDREN IN THE AMOUNT OF ONE HUNDRED MILLION PESOS (P100,000,000.0 0) TO BE KNOWN AS CHILDREN'S WELFARE FUND, TO BE CONSTITUTED FROM THE FOLLOWWING SOURCES:  1) P50 M - National Treasury; 2) P30M - President's Contingency Fund; and 3) P20M - PCSO.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR MALVERSATION OF PUBLIC FUNDS, ROBBERY OR THEFT OF RELIEF GOODS INTENDED FOR CALAMITY VICTIMS
rows.abstract: Any person who commits malversation of public funds, robbery or theft of relief goods intended for calamity victims shall be punished by an imprisonment of not less than twelve years or more than twenty years, or a fine equivalent to the amount embezzled, robbed, or unlawfully taken, but in no case less than twenty thousand pesos (P20,000.00), or both such fine and imprisonment, at the discretion of the court.  In case the offender is a government official/employ ee, he shall, in addition to the penalty provided herein, be dismissed from the service and disqualified from holding any public office.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS OF THE ANTI-CARNAPPING LAW, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE, AS AMENDED BY SECTION TWENTY OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVEN THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED FIFTY-NINE, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT PREVENTING AND PENALIZING CARNAPPING
rows.abstract: Rationale: Recently, carnapping has become rampant in Metro Manila as well as in other provinces. Many times car owners suddenly discover that the vehicle they left securely locked in a parking area vanished without a trace.  And the situation has worsened through the course of time - carnappers have become bolder and have performed carnapping feats that would have been once upon a time impossible. It is no longer safe for the common citizen to leave his vehicle on a guarded parking area such as that in the airport, shopping center or church.  The luxury car models have become too enticing for the carnappers and the plain ones are irresistibly easy for the taking. Carnappers have become bolder.  By increasing the penalties for violating thhe Anti-Carnapping Law, this bill will serve as a deterrent to those who continue to engage in this dangerous trade.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2001-08-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE GLORIFICATION OF GUNS AND VIOLENCE IN MOVIE, TELEVISION, RADIO, PRINT MEDIA AND OTHER SIMILAR MEDIUM AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: The glorification of gunds and violence in movie, television, radio, print media and other similar medium shall be prohibited. For the purpose of this Act, the term "glorification" shall mean: the portrayal of the use of gunds or the act of violenceas an approved and accepted normal or ordinary way of life; or when the presentation is given a favorable aspect, dignifying the violent act and showing that its portrayal is worthy of praise and emulation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2001-08-06

rows.abstract: This bill aims to assist small, medium and new technology enterprises (SMEs/NTEs) in obtaining their financing requirements from the developing capital market in the country. In particular, this measure proposes the establishment of a stock exchangethat will cater to SMEs/NTEs. A Small and Medium Enterprises Stock Exchange (SMEX) can be the equities market of growing businesses that may still not meet the capitalization requirements for public listing by the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE). Public listing in the SMEX may well provide SMEs/NTEs with a cheap and steady pool of funds for their business requirements.

rows.abstract: "National Land Use Act of the Philippines". This proposed National Land Use Policy Act intends to help stop the alarming rate of environment degradation and threats to our food security. It has a strong bias for two basic uses of land resources: land for production and ecological/envi ronmental protection. > This proposed national land use policy is therefore radical. It is radical in the sense that it intends to set aside land in permanence for the main purpose of agricultural production and environment protection.
